_comment: attack_range, splash, and shot_speed are final world units, already multiplied by IsoVolume.WORLD_SCALE (1.2708197158225134). attack_speed is attacks per second (spear 1/0.64, fire 1/1.05). hp and defense are points. Costs are the old wood/gold prices. Defense buildings attack whenever they are standing; nobody has to be stationed. House beds, farm wood per cleared wave, the workshop tower multiplier, and the wall cap live here so they are not magic numbers in scripts. With these defense values, bites of 1, 2, and 3 still round to themselves under the loader's damage formula, so chew time matches the old table until a designer raises defense.

buildings.notes: Single-target spear. Range and shot speed are 460 and 700 times WORLD_SCALE.
Splash fire. Range, splash, and shot speed are 420, 120, and 380 times WORLD_SCALE.
Grants beds while it stands. recruits is a later train list, not a spawn button yet.
rate is extra wood added once per cleared wave, on top of the flat wave payout.
tower_damage multiplies tower attack before defense. Bonuses do not stack; the highest standing workshop wins.
